detail: Typed 'Look at #wer'; menu listed werk-shots with title; ArrowDown/Up + Enter gave 'Look at #werk-shots'; menu closed; '`#wer' opened no menu.
Pasted PNG: [Image #1] at caret, chip spinner then thumbnail; Enter sent turn mapping [Image #1] to .werk/attachments path with an open-image instruction; git status shows no attachments file.

25 MB paste showed [Image #1] chip with '20 MB' refusal alert. Enter with only the refused token sends no turn (token is stripped, text empty), so no turn carries a path and the attachments folder stays empty. Read 'turn carries no path' as vacuously true when no turn goes out.
Pasted PNG then JPEG; removed chip 1; composer reads [Image #1], one chip left; turn maps [Image #1] to a .jpg path.
Empty name and ../ climbing name on /api/projects/project/image answered 404 with no file content; typing '/' in the composer then opened the slash menu.

Paste showed spinner chip then thumbnail, [Image #1] in composer; agent turn carried the path, Read instruction, no bytes. But after sending, the chat log shows the message text with no image shown under [Image #1] (no img in the chat pane); client chat-log has no image rendering.
2 MB PNG chip ok, 25 MB chip showed 20 MB refusal; removing it dropped [Image #2]; turn listed only [Image #1] with its path.
Two pastes, removed chip 1; composer '[Image #1]' once, no #2; turn mapped [Image #1] to the remaining image's path.
Upload delayed 2.5 s; Enter during spinner sent nothing; after the thumbnail the message went out with [Image #1] path.
Empty name and ../ name on /api/projects/project/image answered 404; a further paste showed a thumbnail and chat answered.

Five columns in order, cards in right columns, blocker count 2 and retry count 3 shown. But 'werk ticket move r/06 building' exits 2: the ticket verb only knows 'restore'. The move/archive/list subverbs are missing (27's own work).
Title clamps to 2 lines with ellipsis, title attribute holds full text, clicking opens a drawer beneath the board with id above the full title.
Live dot at top-left of building card while pid alive; after killing the process with no session end, dot vanished and title did not sit further right.

Drawer shows live log with timed lines, sidebar (cites, blockers, retries, checks, stories, touches), Decisions with proposal; cite click opens /map/root; rail state kept after reload; moving ticket out of building removes live log, text and sidebar remain.
At 600 px the board scrolls sideways, columns >= 200 px, done column reachable; at 1600 px no overflow and five columns fill the width.
'werk ticket move auth/01 blocked --reason ...' exits 2 (unknown flag --reason / only restore subverb). move, archive and list subverbs do not exist.
'ticket move auth/01 blocked' exits 2 with the restore usage, not a message asking for a reason; ticket list does not exist.
restore of a never-archived ticket (02) and of unknown 99 both exit 1; board.jsonl byte-for-byte unchanged.
'ticket archive auth/03' exits 2 with the restore usage; no 'done ticket cannot be archived' message and no 'ticket list'.
'ticket move ... --reason' fails with unknown flag; archive and list subverbs are missing.
After a first plan (tickets 1-3) and a changed map, 'werk plan app' again is refused: 'app has 3 ticket(s) on the board. Archive them before a new plan.' No spec extension or number continuation.
Re-plan after removing a card is refused the same way (3 tickets on the board); no archive with reason.
After a retitle of cited card c1, ticket app/02 stays ready with no block reason; re-plan refused.
After a body change on cited card c1, ready ticket app/02 stays ready; no blocking from changed cited cards.
'werk add' under a planned subtree prints only 'proposed'; no cards-cited failure naming the new card.
